d:
At 50% larger than his first dredge, Tony's new $1.5 million beast has massive gold-catching potential if it can actually make it to the cut in one piece. Before it can wash a single ounce of paydirt, Tony and his crew must completely dismantle the colossal machine and haul it 100 miles upriver using his newly acquired tug and barge. Watch the high-stakes logistics, heavy lifting, and sheer willpower behind one of the most ambitious transport missions in Yukon gold mining history.
Watch Gold Rush Season 7, Episode 9 on Discovery Channel India.
